meaning:
ἀπο-γίνομαι (cl. -γίγν-)
[in LXX: Da TH Dan.2:1 * ;]
1. to be away, removed from.
2. to depart life, to die (MM, see word): τ. ἀμαρτίαις, i.e. with ref. to sins, 1Pe.2:24 (Cremer, 149, 668).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.
